copy.promise: Give the next session what this one learned.
open: Coding agents are wordcels. They think in words.
Then the chat closes, and the words are gone.

steps.heading: Save it once
steps.body: One command saves a decision as a Markdown note, and exact search finds it again.

steps.heading: A plain file
steps.body: The note is an ordinary Markdown file you can open, edit and commit.

steps.heading: Your agent checks first
steps.body: Before it edits a file, your agent finds the rule and says which note it came from.

proof.caption: Free and MIT licensed. Exact search needs no model or account.

items.label: notes per vault for graph queries
links deep a graph query can follow

limits.heading: What it does not do
limits.body: It finds notes. Your agent writes the answer, and a note can still be wrong.

end.line: Free and open source. Named for roon’s essay A Song of Shapes and Words.
